display_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-07-CLIMA-CIT-CCRI-02 Deploying innovative wastewater management, treatment and valorisation solutions in European cities and regions in the context of climate change – Horizon Europe
call_title: Joint Call between the Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities Mission and the Adaptation to Climate Change Mission (HORIZON-MISS-2027-07)
call_module_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-07-CLIMA-CIT-CCRI-02 Deploying innovative wastewater management, treatment and valorisation solutions in European cities and regions in the context of climate change
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Mission Innovation Action, jointly under the Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities Mission and the Adaptation to Climate Change Mission, that funds integrated urban and regional wastewater management, treatment, reuse and valorisation demonstrators, including nature-based and storm-water solutions and energy efficiency and recovery at sewers and wastewater treatment plants (for example solar, waste heat or biogas), up to TRL 7-8. Consortia must include entities from at least four cities or regions in different Member States or Associated Countries, with at least one from the 112 Cities Mission cities and one Adaptation Mission Charter signatory, and the local water management organisation; entities controlled from China are excluded. Actual-cost grant at the Innovation Action rates (70% for for-profit entities, up to 100% for non-profit). Indicative topic budget EUR 28.5 million, around EUR 9.5 million per project. Planned opening 9 February 2027; single-stage deadline 22 September 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 12 (Missions), pp. 243–246, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-MISS-2027-07-CLIMA-CIT-CCRI-02, funds demonstrators of urban wastewater treatment, reuse and resource recovery in cities and regions, led by local water management organisations. It does not touch TenneT's field: the energy elements are local energy efficiency and recovery at treatment plants (solar, waste heat, biogas) under the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive, with no link to the transmission grid, flexibility or system operation, and no project file is close to it. No project date is set because the call states no start, end or duration.
